Fictional interview for product acceptance testing. No real customer data.
Company: Ridge Labs
Meeting date: 2026-11-03

[00:12] Interviewer: How do you run simulations today?
[00:20] Customer, engineering manager: We run one simulation each week in a browser and share the environment across our three-person team.
[00:44] Customer, engineering manager: We do not need an API to create a fresh simulation for every CI run. The manual workflow works for us.
[01:08] Customer, engineering manager: Our biggest problem is explaining the result to the rest of the team. We copy screenshots into a document.
[01:32] Interviewer: What have you tried?
[01:38] Customer, engineering manager: A shared report link would save us time, but I have not evaluated a new tool or budget.
